verdict.rationale: The Nitrokey 3 firmware repository states the software is fully open source, written in Rust on the Trussed framework, and dual-licensed Apache 2.0/MIT. A runtime probe confirms public tagged releases (v1.8.3) and a documented firmware-update path. One caveat: a community report says the Nitrokey HSM's internal applet is not open source, so openness is not uniform across the product line. Missing for 10: any evidence of an independent security audit, a way to verify that the flashed binary matches the public source (e.g. reproducible builds), and open firmware for the HSM model.
